Maria: Quick question from today's all-hands — what's the exact behavior when a customer hits their monthly credits and continues to call the hosted API? Are calls blocked, queued, or sent to a fallback model? Also how do rate cap grace bursts interact with quotas?

Jordan: Short answer: default is we reject once credits are exhausted (billing error 402) unless the account has auto-recharge or a paid plan. Fallback routing to cheaper models is not automatic for all accounts today. Rate caps are a separate enforcement layer; grace bursts smooth short spikes but don't bypass quota accounting.

Liz: Ops note: For Dedicated customers we don't enforce hosted credits because they use reserved capacity. For hosted accounts, requests past credits will be declined unless billing/auto-charge kicks in.

Sam (CEO): Good callout — docs need to be clearer. Roadmap note: automatic fallback routing (route-to-cheaper-model on credits-exhausted) is planned for Q3, but we have an opt-in routing feature available now via account-level `fallback_policy` in Console.

Maria: @Sam can you clarify "opt-in"? Is that per-account setting or per-route?

Sam (CEO): Per-account today; per-route rollout is in the beta for Dedicated next month. We'll announce the beta in the product channel once it's ready.

Jordan: Implementation detail: the rate-limiter exposes headers you can read: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`. We also include `X-RateLimit-Burst-Remaining` to show grace capacity.

Liz: Example fallback config we use in Console (paste-ready):
```
fallback_policy: {
  when: 'credits_exhausted'
  action: 'route_to:model:rw-compact'
}
```

Maria: Thanks. One more — how do quotas interact with streaming APIs? If a token cap is hit mid-stream, does the client get truncated output or an error event?

Jordan: Streaming will truncate and send a final event with `quota_exceeded`. SDKs surface this as an exception/error. We also emit audit logs with `quota_exceeded` events for observability.

finance-bot: Billing FYI — accounts with auto-recharge enabled will be charged and access resumes; customers get an invoice. Links: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices

Sam (CEO): Action item: we'll add a KB this week that covers credits, auto-recharge behavior, rate-limit headers, and fallback config. @Maria can you own the draft?

Maria: Happy to. I'll draft the KB and drop it in #docs later today. :+1:
